text:
Silver Price in 2004
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2004, the LBMA silver price rose 9.5% between 2004-01-30 ($6.23) and 2004-12-31 ($6.82). The highest sampled price was $7.83 in March and the lowest was $5.91 in June. The mean of these observations was $6.68. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
